name: Sical Logistics Limited
summary: Sical Logistics Limited, founded in 1955 and based in Bengaluru, provides integrated logistics across India. It handles dry and liquid bulk cargo at ports, runs a container terminal at Tuticorin and freight stations in Chennai, Vizag and Tuticorin, and offers customs brokerage, vessel chartering, shipping agency and stevedoring. It also moves bulk, project and oversized cargo by road.
